messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT: inference-service-us-west - error-rate spike > 6% across 3 hosts. Pager: PD_INC_3419001111

maya (oncall): acked. i'm looking. any quick notes on customer impact?

liam: incoming - i'm 2min out, transferring ownership if maya wants to pass.

maya (oncall): handing to liam. i'm tied up with a billing degradation call. liam, pd ownership transferred.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: ack recorded by maya (oncall). escalation policy: realtime-ops -> slo-owners.

liam: thanks. first pass — rolling 500 errors are mainly 500/502 from model-hosts 12/13/14. seeing increased latency too.

zoe: tagging infra: possible autoscaler flaps? saw a scale-down event 3m before spike.

liam: good catch. checking autoscaler logs now.

sre-bot: autoscaler event: scaleDown triggered at 3419000800 for pool-inference-us-west (reason: cpu<25% for 10m).

liam: that aligns. looks like capacity dropped and then traffic burst caused queue overload -> upstream 502.

maya (oncall): customer impact: some customers report timeouts in chat flows, intermittent 5xx on generation endpoints. severity: P2 for now, but could escalate if SLA errors continue.

liam: mitigation plan: 1) pause scale-down / set min replicas to current count, 2) bring up a replacement host, 3) enable fallback routing to ded-variant for critical tenants. doing 1 and 2 now.

ops-eng: running command to set min_replicas=4 for pool-inference-us-west:
```
$ infractl pool update pool-inference-us-west --min-replicas 4
Result: accepted (job 9876)
```

liam: creating replacement host (spinup request to k8s nodepool); ETA ~ 2m.

zoe: enabling temporary routing fallback (route policy swap) for critical_tenants route.

liam: replacement host joined, health checks OK. traffic gradually shifting back.

pagerbot: Alert update: error-rate reduced from 6.3% -> 1.1% over last 90s.

maya (oncall): nice. confirm customer-facing errors dropping?

liam: yes, logs show 5xx at ~120/s -> ~10/s. continuing to monitor. keeping page open until stable 0.5% for 5m.

sre-bot: rolling avg latency for generation endpoint: 85ms -> 140ms during spike -> now 95ms.

zoe: will follow up with autoscaler team to adjust scale-down thresholds. leaving a follow-up ticket: INF-5467.

maya (oncall): creating incident record and note for postmortem; adding customer impact and timeline. maya will hand back on-call to rotation after wrap.

liam: handing back to maya. leaving runbook notes: raised min_replicas, spun replacement host, enabled fallback routing, created INF-5467.

maya (oncall): thx. reassigning ownership to maya (oncall). closing PD incident pending 20m stable window.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: incident PD_INC_3419001111 set to resolved by maya (oncall) at 3419001790 (pending manual close).

ops-eng: postmortem owners: zoe (infra), liam (runtime), maya (onsite). will schedule async writeup. :memo:

liam: quick note — consider lowering scaleDown aggressiveness for inference pools handling bursty traffic.

maya (oncall): agreed. thanks team. closing thread once we hit stable window. :white_check_mark:
